answers.core: I think this could *probably* be implemented as an add-on, but it's editor only and doesn't add any deps so it's fairly lightweight. The other consideration is it's there to catch peoples' mistakes, and if I don't know that sub-sonic sounds are likely to cause problems then I'm probably not likely to download an add-on designed to identify them.

title: Warn users about sub-sonic audio resources or better handle fade-out of low-frequency sounds
